method: Direct view_image inspection of the exact workspace PNG at original detail; no metadata-to-pixel inference

gates.criterion: All three period-fashion components are visible together: cropped sporty baby tee, low-rise roomy nylon track pants, chunky platform sneakers.
gates.evidence: The same full-body subject wears a visibly cropped white/blue sporty tee, roomy cobalt low-waist nylon pants and thick-soled white sneakers. All three coexist in the saved frame.

gates.criterion: A cropped baby tee has a short body, fitted sporty shape and contrasting raglan sleeves.
gates.evidence: The tee has a short fitted body above the navel and contrasting sky-blue raglan sleeves/neck trim against a white body; fabric remains wearable and distinct from background.

gates.criterion: A visibly low waistband and roomy nylon track-pant legs with side piping coexist.
gates.evidence: A low elastic waistband sits below the visible navel. Wide cobalt nylon legs show glossy folds and a white outer-side piping line from waist toward ankle.

gates.criterion: Both feet wear recognizably chunky-soled platform sneakers.
gates.evidence: Both feet are visible in white lace-up sneakers with thick raised platform-like midsoles; each outsole is distinct against the pavement.

gates.criterion: Slim tinted wraparound sunglasses on the head and a thin hip chain at the waist are legible.
gates.evidence: Slim dark tinted sunglasses with a metallic curved frame rest on the dark bob above the forehead; a fine silver chain visibly runs across the low waist.

gates.criterion: One basketball is secured by two opposite-side hands near chest height, with bent elbows, flexed knees and a plausible two-foot landing on ground below a hoop.
gates.scope: main subject body, ball and ground
gates.evidence: One basketball sits at chest height with hands on opposing sides and bent elbows. The subject holds a grounded wide landing stance with flexed knees, both shoes on paving, and a portable hoop above/behind her. The exact preceding rebound time cannot be proved from a still image; the frozen visible state is present.

gates.criterion: Airborne paper flyers visibly originate around an open crate beside a parked speaker cart, and a separate adult attendant reaches toward them.
gates.evidence: Several separated flyers float above and beside an open plastic crate on a stationary music equipment cart. A separate adult attendant on the right extends a hand directly toward a near flyer. The airborne paper and reach share one coherent space.

gates.criterion: A silver portable CD player with visible disc/lid character sits on the cart beside recognizable speakers.
gates.evidence: A silver portable CD player has a visible transparent circular lid/disc on the foreground case, and headphones lie beside it. The cart reads as a road case/crate; no recognizable loudspeaker cone or grille is visible in the saved frame. The required CD-player-plus-speakers combination is only partly realized, so partial_is_fail applies.

gates.criterion: The frame includes an outdoor fountain plaza, temporary festival canopies and a portable basketball hoop/court.
gates.evidence: The frame contains clear open sky/daylight, multiple fountain jets, temporary white festival canopies and a portable basketball backboard/hoop. Court markings and paving are visible around both feet.

gates.criterion: The generated subject reads as adult and uses the observed dark bob/fringe, dark eyes and light skin as external appearance guidance, with face sufficiently visible for this limited check.
gates.evidence: The main subject is represented as adult, with a dark chin-length bob and separated fringe, visible dark eyes/eyelids, light skin and softly colored lips. This is limited external appearance correspondence; no identity or actual age claim is made.

data_causality: New y2kr candidates exposed/adopted: 0/0; Y2K-specific optional profiles discovered: 0. Clothing fidelity is evidence for the independently authored baseline, not proof of improvement caused by this data expansion.
